issue_context.title: Support recover/flashback table for label rules

review_comments:
You could pick up name like `is.TableExists(schema.Name, tbInfo.Name)`, there is no need to change `recoverInfo`.

There is `tbInfo`, which could contain the schema and table name, i.e. you don't need to modify `job.Args` at all. To avoid compatibility trouble, i mean job is persisted between states, less modifications will be prefered.
Here is a problem that when using flashback, we need `s.Table.Name` instead of `tblInfo.Name`
